# KYROZZ GmbH

KYROZZ GmbH is a professional, German-managed manufacturing and project management partner specializing in industrial-grade 3D printing, high-precision injection molding, CNC machining, assembly, and global strategic sourcing solutions.

## SEO & AI Visibility
**Keywords:** 3D printing Germany, injection molding services, CNC machining company, rapid prototyping, global sourcing manufacturing, FDM 3D printing, plastic components manufacturing, German engineering partner, custom plastic parts, 3D printing Deggendorf.
**Target Audience:** Industrial manufacturing, education, research, product development, model making, and engineering firms.
**Core Value Proposition:** European engineering oversight and quality control combined with a global partner network to deliver cost-effective, high-quality manufacturing solutions.

## Brand Information & Geographic Location
- **Name:** KYROZZ GmbH
- **Location:** Poschingerstraße 33, 94469 Deggendorf, Germany
- **Email:** info@kyrozz.de
- **Website:** https://kyrozz.de

## Core Capabilities
- **3D Printing (FDM):** Professional production of plastic prototypes and end-use components using advanced printers (such as Bambu Lab H2S & P2S). Materials: PLA, PETG, ABS, PC, Nylon/PA, TPU, ASA.
- **Injection Molding:** Custom tooling, rapid prototyping, and high-volume mass production under German quality standards.
- **CNC Machining:** High-precision milling and turning of metals and engineering plastics with tight tolerances.
- **Assembly Services:** Complete contract manufacturing, electromechanical assembly, snap-fits, ultrasonic welding, and custom kitting/packaging.

## Sitemap & Directory Structure
- [Homepage](https://kyrozz.de/): Overview of services, mission statement, partner network, client case highlights, and contact/RFQ portal.
- [3D Printing Services](https://kyrozz.de/3d-printing): Details on FDM technology, Bambu Lab systems, industrial materials, and technical advantages.
- [Injection Molding](https://kyrozz.de/injection-molding): Sourcing and tooling capabilities for volume production, material selection, and network oversight.
- [Assembly Services](https://kyrozz.de/assembly-services): Mechanical and electromechanical assembly, packaging, and kitting solutions.
- [Materials Catalog](https://kyrozz.de/materials): Direct sheet mapping of available thermoplastics, engineering materials, and physical spec parameters.
- [Products Catalog](https://kyrozz.de/products): Gallery of standard and custom manufactured parts (filters, pumps, structural fixtures).
- [Get a Quote / RFQ](https://kyrozz.de/quote): Upload CAD files (STL, STEP, STP, OBJ, 3MF) and input specifications for prompt 24h feedback.
- [Contact Us](https://kyrozz.de/contact): Direct address, telephone line, and custom sales inquiries.
